review: 702.29d-1: the does_not_fire variant moved Drake Haven to B, which flips the 'you' condition rather than the once-per-cycle rule 702.29d decides; replaced it with a discard-by-Tormenting-Voice variant showing the same single trigger, added the lands and card it needs, and noted that a count rule has no does_not_fire branch.

scenarios.title: Cycling discards the card as a cost and draws a card, and only works from hand

setup.notes: Library lists the top card first. B has no permanents and no cards.

decisions: A activates the cycling ability of Lonely Sandbar from hand, paying {U} by tapping Island; Lonely Sandbar is discarded as part of the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: from_hand
variants.expected: Lonely Sandbar is in A's graveyard as soon as the ability is activated (cost). When the ability resolves A draws Mountain: A's hand is [Mountain] and A's library is [Swamp].

variants.label: on_battlefield
variants.delta: Lonely Sandbar is on A's battlefield (untapped) instead of in A's hand.
variants.expected: Activating the cycling ability is illegal (can_play false): Lonely Sandbar stays on the battlefield, nothing is discarded, nothing is drawn, Island stays untapped.

variants.label: cost_unpayable
variants.expected: Activating the cycling ability is illegal (can_play false) because {U} cannot be paid: Lonely Sandbar stays in A's hand and nothing is drawn.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the on_battlefield variant the land is untapped so that tapping it for mana is not what makes the activation fail; its only activated abilities are the mana ability and cycling.

scenarios.title: A land with cycling on the battlefield still counts as having a non-mana activated ability

setup.notes: A's untap step is the next step of the game after B's end step and cleanup: the decisions skip to it.

decisions: Both players pass through the rest of B's turn; no spells or abilities are used.
A's turn begins and A's untap step untaps A's permanents.

variants.label: cycling_land
variants.expected: Tsabo's Web stops Lonely Sandbar from untapping: it has cycling, an activated ability that is not a mana ability, even on the battlefield. Lonely Sandbar is still tapped after A's untap step.

variants.label: plain_land
variants.delta: The tapped land is Island instead of Lonely Sandbar.
variants.expected: Island has only a mana ability, so Tsabo's Web does not affect it: Island is untapped after A's untap step.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's hasNonManaActivatedAbility filter may or may not count the keyword-derived cycling ability on a battlefield permanent; if it does not, the fires variant is a Forge discrepancy.

scenarios.title: A 'when you cycle this card' ability triggers on cycling and not on an ordinary discard

setup.notes: Glory Seeker is a 2/2 Human Soldier with no abilities. Library lists the top card first.

decisions: A activates the cycling ability of Gempalm Avenger, paying {2}{W} by tapping Plains, Mountain and Mountain; Gempalm Avenger is discarded as part of the cost.
The cycle trigger goes on the stack above the draw ability. Both players pass; the trigger resolves, then both players pass again and the draw ability resolves.

variants.label: cycled
variants.expected: The trigger 'when you cycle Gempalm Avenger' fires from the graveyard, where the card now is. Glory Seeker becomes 3/3 with first strike until end of turn. A then draws Plains.

variants.label: discarded
variants.delta: Instead of cycling, A casts Tormenting Voice (paying {1}{R} with the two Mountains) and discards Gempalm Avenger as its additional cost.
variants.expected: Gempalm Avenger is in A's graveyard but no trigger fires: it was discarded, not cycled. Glory Seeker stays a 2/2 with no first strike. A draws Plains and Mountain.

scenarios.title: A 'cycles or discards' ability triggers once when a card is cycled

setup.notes: Library lists the top card first. The Mountains and Tormenting Voice are used only by the discarded variant.

decisions: A activates the cycling ability of Lonely Sandbar, paying {U} by tapping an Island; Lonely Sandbar is discarded as part of the cost.
Drake Haven's trigger goes on the stack; A pays {1} by tapping the other Island when it resolves.
Both players pass until the trigger and the draw ability have resolved.

variants.label: own_haven
variants.expected: Drake Haven triggers exactly once for the one card cycled: A creates exactly one 2/2 blue Drake token with flying, and then draws one card (Island).

variants.label: discarded
variants.delta: Instead of cycling, A casts Tormenting Voice (paying {1}{R} with the two Mountains) and discards Lonely Sandbar as its additional cost; A pays Drake Haven's {1} with an Island.
variants.expected: Drake Haven triggers exactly once for the one card discarded: A creates exactly one 2/2 blue Drake token with flying, and Tormenting Voice draws A two cards (Island, Island).

scenarios.forge_notes: 702.29d is a count (one trigger, not two), so it has no does_not_fire branch: no legal situation makes a cycled card trigger a 'cycles or discards' ability zero or two times. The discarded variant shows a cycle and a plain discard trigger it the same single time.

scenarios.title: Typecycling discards the card and searches the library for a card of the type
decisions: A activates the Plainscycling ability of Eternal Dragon, paying {2} by tapping both Islands; Eternal Dragon is discarded as part of the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves. A searches for a Plains card, reveals it and puts it into hand, and the library is shuffled.

variants.label: plains_in_library
variants.expected: Eternal Dragon is in A's graveyard. A's hand is [Plains] (no card is drawn) and A's library is [Island, Swamp] in shuffled order.

variants.label: no_plains
variants.delta: A's library is [Island, Swamp] with no Plains.
variants.expected: Eternal Dragon is in A's graveyard. The search finds nothing: A's hand is empty and the library is shuffled.

scenarios.title: An effect that stops players from cycling stops typecycling
decisions: A tries to activate the Plainscycling ability of Eternal Dragon, paying {2} by tapping both Islands.

variants.label: with_stabilizer
variants.expected: The activation is illegal (can_play false): Stabilizer says players can't cycle cards, and typecycling is cycling. Eternal Dragon stays in A's hand.

variants.label: without_stabilizer
variants.delta: Stabilizer is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The activation is legal (can_play true); Eternal Dragon is discarded as a cost.

scenarios.forge_notes: Stabilizer is implemented as CantBeActivated for ValidSA$ Activated.Cycling; check that Forge's Cycling filter includes TypeCycling abilities.

scenarios.title: Typecycling triggers 'whenever a player cycles a card' abilities, an ordinary discard does not
decisions: A activates the Plainscycling ability of Eternal Dragon, paying {2} by tapping two Mountains; Eternal Dragon is discarded as part of the cost.
Lightning Rift's trigger goes on the stack; when it resolves A pays {1} by tapping the third Mountain and chooses player B as the target.
Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: typecycled
variants.expected: Lightning Rift triggers on the typecycling: A pays {1} and the Rift deals 2 damage to B (B's life 20 to 18). The search puts Plains into A's hand.

variants.label: discarded
variants.delta: Instead of typecycling, A casts Tormenting Voice (paying {1}{R}) and discards Eternal Dragon as its additional cost.
variants.expected: Lightning Rift does not trigger: Eternal Dragon was discarded, not cycled. B's life stays 20. A draws Plains and Mountain.
